sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Accepted: the candidate faithfully targets the ship, preserves explicit restricted/unrestricted applicability branches, uses the restricted output when applicable, and computes unrestricted P from propulsion machinery output plus optional additional propulsion power. Quantity datatypes and kW units are correct, the unrestricted comparison uses permitted arithmetic with tolerance, and prior repair instructions are preserved.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the candidate does not encode the requirement that additional propulsion power sources, such as shaft motors, must be included in the total engine output P. Its unrestricted comparison equates P only with propulsionMachineryContinuousOutput and therefore may omit additional sources.
